findings.title: validateReferences skips ALL answer checks when the referenced question row carries no payload
findings.what: When `answerTo` names a folded `question` row whose `question` payload is absent (a row the fold keeps after reporting 'a `question` row has no question payload'), validateReferences calls no answer validator at all. Probe P10 returns ok for an answer with an EMPTY questionId and a selected label the question never offered, even though amended I5 says the answer's questionId is REQUIRED and non-empty.
findings.why: Reachable only through an already-corrupt mailbox whose anomaly the fold reports (I8), so the blast radius is small and a caller that reads fold problems is warned. But validateReferences is documented as the I5 gate, and it currently accepts an answer whose context-free I5 field is empty — the amended rule makes that field required regardless of the target's payload.
findings.direction: In that branch, still call validateAnswer(envelope.answer) (context-free rules: non-empty questionId/answerTo, label-or-custom) and add a problem saying the referenced question carries no payload. Non-blocking for this wave; the cheap fix lives entirely in the protocol package.
